Scope of works

From the baseline narrative
Electrical works

One additional 33/11 kV 20 MVA transformer with 33 kV, 11 kV, LV, control and comms cabling, earthing, LVAC extension.

Civil works

Transformer bay modifications: excavation, RC foundations and plinths, cable trenches, waterproofing, reinstatement.

Mechanical works

Modify, relocate and recommission the existing fire protection system around the new bay.

Protection

Relay modifications, CT interfaces, BCPU, coordination studies, settings and functional testing.

DMS / SCADA

Integration of the new transformer and feeders into ADMS: database, point-to-point and acceptance tests.

33 kV interconnector

New 33 kV cable BAHPRY ⇄ BAHPRY3: trenching, laying, jointing, terminations, energisation.

External 11 kV network

11 kV load-transfer cabling with joints, terminations, tiles, markers and reinstatement.

Common civil infrastructure

Duct banks, NDRC and road crossings, HDPE/PVC ducts, asphalt, paving and kerb reinstatement.

Project support

Site office, Digital PTW, HSE, temporary power, as-builts, O&M manuals, training and handover.

Import updates
